## Details

<a id="unused_cdb6"></a>
### [`unused_cdb6`](../../../../src/data/unused_cdb6.asm#L6) `$CDB6-$CFFF`

*data*

Nothing reads these bytes. They hold the $00/$ff fill pattern of RAM after power-on. The Hotline trainer puts its code at $ce00-$ce0b.
